# Monster Traits

Give a monster Small or Combat Caster, and take off any one trait while keeping the rest.

These go after `newmonster`, `selectmonster`, `newitem` or `selectitem`. A `0` after a trait removes it: `small 0`. With CoE5SE the same works for these game traits:

??? note "Game traits that take `0`"

    `acutesenses`, `allitemslots`, `animal`, `badsight`, `banishsurv`, `berserker`, `bluntres`, `charmres`, `clumsy`, `coldblood`, `curseditem`, `demonic`, `desertstealth`, `diseaseres`, `ethereal`, `fastheal`, `female`, `foreststealth`, `frontpos`, `holy`, `human`, `immortal`, `inanimate`, `invisible`, `invul`, `largeshield`, `lucky`, `magicshield`, `nobootslots`, `nocombat`, `noheal`, `noleader`, `nonmaginvul`, `noslots`, `nozoc`, `pierceres`, `rearpos`, `regeneration`, `shield`, `size1x1`, `size2x2`, `slashres`, `sleepres`, `snowstealth`, `spiritsight`, `stealth`, `swallowres`, `tiny`, `treelook`, `unaging`, `undead`, `unimportant`, `weaponslots`

!!! info "More in the game's manual"
    The game's own monster and item commands are in Illwinter's official modding manual, under ["Monster Modding"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=14) and ["Magic Item Modding"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=10).

### small { #small .command data-toc-label="small" }

Makes the unit small, like the game's Goblins: raised as a Soulless, it rises as a Little Soulless.

=== ".c5se"

    On:

    ```c5se
    small
    ```

    Or off, on a unit that has it:

    ```c5se
    small 0
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    On:

    ```c5m
    #!@small
    ```

    Or off, on a unit that has it:

    ```c5m
    #!@small 0
    ```

### combatcaster { #combatcaster .command data-toc-label="combatcaster" }

Makes the unit a Combat Caster, like the game's Paladins.

=== ".c5se"

    On:

    ```c5se
    combatcaster
    ```

    Or off, on a unit that has it:

    ```c5se
    combatcaster 0
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    On:

    ```c5m
    #!@combatcaster
    ```

    Or off, on a unit that has it:

    ```c5m
    #!@combatcaster 0
    ```

### Example monsters { #example }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newmonster "Hobbit Archer"
    copystats "Spearman"
    copyspr "Spearman"
    small

    selectmonster "Elven Mage"
    combatcaster
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    newmonster "Hobbit Archer"
    copystats "Spearman"
    copyspr "Spearman"
    #!@small

    selectmonster "Elven Mage"
    #!@combatcaster
    ```
